newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistani rupee ends steady in kerb, seen rising.
newsitem.headline: Pakistani rupee ends steady in kerb, seen rising.

text.p: The Pakistani rupee ended steady at 42.05 to the dollar in the kerb market on Monday as traders converted dollars into the local currency to divert it to the stock market, dealers said.
The rupee is likely to open up on Tuesday, one dealer said.
The State (central) bank of Pakistan rate, last changed on October 22, was 40.1200/40.3206 rupees to the dollar.
The premium on foreign exchange bearer certificates closed at 5.15 percent compared with the opening at 5.00 percent.
